Task 2


You will now learn about Task 2.

  • You are remaining with the same person from Task 1.
  • You have the {{ Constants.endowment }} from Task 1 at your disposal for this second task.
  • Each one of you has a 1/3 probability of loosing her/his endowment of {{ Constants.endowment }}.
  • After you made your decision, you have to throw a virtual dice. In case you throw a 1, 2, 3, or 4, you keep the {{ Constants.endowment }}. If you throw a 5 or 6, you loose the {{ Constants.endowment }}. The same applies to the other person.

Your Decision


Prior to throwing the dice you have to take the following decision (see illustration below): How much do you want to transfer to the other person in case she/he is losing his/her endowment, and you keep your endowment?




The other person takes the same decision simultaneously.

Your Final Bonus


Your final bonus thus depends partly on chance, your decision and the decision of the other person.

  • If the other person loses her/his endowment and you keep your endowment, you receive as final bonus {{ Constants.endowment }} minus the transfer to the other person.
  • If you lose your endowment and the other person keeps his/her endowment, you receive as final bonus the transfer of the other person.
  • If neither you nor the other person loses their endowment, you receive the full bonus payment.
  • If you and the other person both lose their endowment, you receive no bonus payment.

Click 'Next' to start with a quiz to test your understanding of the task. Once you proceeded, you cannot go back to this instruction page.
